subject: Re: Status - adopting it as a candidate generator only
body:
Recommendation for the 17th, so nobody is surprised in the room:

We adopt the canonicalization as a candidate generator in the dedup path, with a second-stage attribute comparison that Kaia will spec but that we build in Q3, not now. 11% candidate recall at near-zero cost is worth having even if precision needs a second pass. We do not claim dedup accuracy numbers until the second stage exists - Kaia, please make sure the doc says that in the first paragraph rather than the appendix.

The canonical-form column landed before the freeze, so we are not blocked on Corpus. Thank you Vera and Bruno for taking that seriously in May instead of the week before.

n=10 finished and matched, which is a nice footnote and, to be clear, not why we funded this.

Dmitri
